preamble: Palatalization of the bilabial nasal [m] to the palatal nasal [ɲ] before front vowels, with loss of the labial closure. It is characteristic of Aromanian, where Latin mīlia 'thousands' and Vulgar Latin *miccus 'small' give njilji and njic, where nj spells [ɲ]; Daco-Romanian keeps [m] (mie, mic). Words in which m stood before the glide of a diphthong (Latin mel > Aromanian njari, Romanian miere) are not counted here. Bantu passive and diminutive forms with m > ɲ are morphologically conditioned alternations and are not counted either.
sources: Guia, S. (2020). Palatalizarea consoanelor labiale în româna vorbită dialectală. Proceedings of the International Conference "Communication, Context, Interdisciplinarity" 6: 329–339. https://www.diacronia.ro/en/indexing/details/A32452
